item.title: The Price of winning at the Pau 5-star
item.dc:creator: Nancy Jaffer
item.description: New Zealand’s Price family dominated the season’s final 5-star eventing competition, not just winning but taking five of the top 10 placings at France’s Les Etoiles de Pau. World number one Tim Price and Jarillo added just 5.2 cross-country time penalties to their dressage score, finishing with a fault-free show jumping effort on 30.9 penalties, […]

item.title: An amazing evening at the Washington International Horse Show
item.dc:creator: Nancy Jaffer
item.description: The “next generation” — and the generation after that — dominated the spotlight at the Washington International Horse Show Saturday night, as Lillie Keenan, 30, won the 5-star $340,000 President’s Cup after 16-year-old JJ Torano took the 2-star feature earlier in the day. item.title: NY City carriage horse ban passes, but it’s not the last word yet
item.dc:creator: Nancy Jaffer
item.description: By a 40-7 vote, the New York City Council on Thursday approved a long-debated ban on horse-drawn carriages, as of June 2028. That’s 20 months from now, a long time in which much can happen. Big questions have not been answered, such as how carriage owners will be reimbursed for hundreds of thousands of dollars […]

item.title: Do you have questions about budgeting for horse care?
item.dc:creator: Nancy Jaffer
item.description: Pennsylvania State University is offering a webinar Oct. 20 at noon on finances of horse ownership. For new owners especially, the no-fee presentation can give insight into hidden costs and annual spending for a variety of situations. Click here to register or for more information.
